window: R12+R13 double week · unlimited trades before R14
bottom_line: Two things decide your Round 12. First, a free fix: your current lineup has Davidovac and Joksimović in active slots while Nunn, Diarra and Malcolm sit on the half-points bench, and reordering alone is worth about +11 points. Second, your coach: Partizan are 42% underdogs at home to Valencia, so the expected return is about +1. Fenerbahçe (83% vs ASVEL, then at struggling Milano in R13) is the best coach for the whole double week. Variation A does both with only 2 trades and keeps 2 in hand for Tuesday's injury news.
current_fix: Before any trade: move Nunn, Diarra and Malcolm into the active five, put Madar as 6th man, and send Davidovac (5.5 proj, 12 min, 20% starts) and Joksimović (3.2 PIR/game) to the bench. Same 10 players: about 122 → 133 projected points. Keep Feliz in the starting five; he is your only Wednesday player, which keeps a late captain/backup option open.

variations.name: Balanced: coach fix + guard upgrade
variations.tagline: Fix the biggest leak (coach), upgrade Nunn to a cheaper guard with a bigger role, and keep 2 trades for the Tuesday injury report.

trades.why: Partizan 42% at home to Valencia (proj −2): expected about +1. Fenerbahçe 83% vs ASVEL (proj +10): about +12.5, and R13 is at Milano (19th, new coach Banchi still installing his system). The best coach over both double-week rounds.

Punter is out about 3 weeks with an ankle injury, so Robinson becomes Barcelona's lead ball-handler. Home vs Paris (fastest pace in the league, weak defence) in R12, home vs Zvezda in R13, no back-to-back. Nunn starts only 25% of the time in a crowded Panathinaikos backcourt and has a B2B at Zalgiris.

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov: 23 PIR projected, 30 min, 79% win at Maccabi, a floor of about 14 even in a bad game. Feliz is your only Wednesday (T2) player. If Vezenkov flops on Tuesday you can't move the captaincy after he's played, so decide before Tuesday tip-off. Keep Feliz in the five so the option exists if late news hits Vezenkov.
reasoning: Coach lens: Real Madrid are without Campazzo, Maledon, Deck and Jantunen. Feliz played 33.9 minutes last round, and the Wednesday game at Beşiktaş (also missing Nowell, Jeffries and Korkmaz) keeps him a heavy-minutes starter.
Malcolm is starting and playing 30 minutes. R12 at Dubai is tough (25% win), but R13 vs ASVEL is the best matchup on your team (15.2 projected). Keep him through the double week.
Diarra: 1.0 PIR per minute is elite. Virtus are underdogs to Panathinaikos (Lessort matchup), but he's 38% owned. Selling him is a rank risk and his price is still rising.
Madar as 6th man rather than a starter: Maccabi are 21% vs Olympiacos and he plays the same game as your captain. Not a starter for this matchup.
Faye is benched, not sold. He just scored 20.9 in the buzzer-beater win over Fenerbahçe, so his price rises after R11. Selling him next window, at the higher price, is better value.
2 trades held: use them Monday night if the injury report changes things (Campazzo return would cut Feliz's minutes; Koloko's visa issue affects Zvezda's frontcourt).
cancel_if: Robinson is listed doubtful on Monday's injury report: then keep Nunn.
Fenerbahçe rule out two starters: switch the coach to Zalgiris (80% vs Bayern, 7.3 credits, leaves 1.2 in the bank).

variations.name: Zalgiris stack: high ceiling
variations.tagline: Bet on one correlated outcome: Zalgiris beat Bayern by double digits. Valančiūnas and the Zalgiris coach both pay out if it happens.

trades.why: 23 PIR over his last 3 games. Bayern are weak on the defensive glass, and Zalgiris are 80% at home. Only 16% owned, so this is a differential.
Pure funding move. With Campazzo and Maledon out, Llull gets about 20 minutes and has a Wednesday game.
80% win, projected +11. Correlated with Valančiūnas: a blowout pays both.

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov stays captain. Valančiūnas is the vice and the higher-ceiling pick if you're chasing: a blowout of Bayern can produce 30+ PIR. He plays at 20:00 Tuesday, one hour after Vezenkov, so you can't switch based on Vezenkov's result.
reasoning: This gives up guard depth (Nunn out, Llull in) to buy the best centre available in R12.
The problem is R13: Zalgiris host Panathinaikos on a back-to-back, so you'd likely need to change the coach again before R13 and use a trade on it.
Valančiūnas is 34. On a B2B against Panathinaikos expect fewer minutes (about 20) and foul-trouble risk against Lessort.
Choose this if you're behind in your league and need a swing. It's the wrong choice if you're protecting a lead.
cancel_if: Valančiūnas sits out Zalgiris' LKL game on the weekend with any knock.
Bayern announce their whole rotation is fit (the margin projection shrinks).

variations.name: Sell-high + double-week builder
variations.tagline: Optimise R12 and R13 together: Barcelona's home double (Paris, then Zvezda) with no back-to-backs, cashing out Feliz at his price peak.

trades.why: Same as A: the best coach across both rounds.
26 minutes and a 16 PIR average while Barcelona's frontcourt is thin. Home vs Paris (Faye's own team) and home vs a Zvezda side missing Koloko, Motley and Miljenović. Two home games, no B2B.

Sell high: Feliz is +3.1 since the start and 36% owned. His 33.9-minute role depends on injured guards, and Campazzo (awaiting tests) or Maledon returning would cut it. He also has a B2B at Olympiacos in R13.

variations.captain_note: Vezenkov. Robinson is the vice: Barcelona at home with a 68% win chance.
reasoning: This is the strongest R13 squad of the three: Robinson, Nebo, Vezenkov and Malcolm all have good R13 games and no back-to-backs.
3 Barcelona players (Robinson, Nebo, Brizuela) are all in one game vs Paris. That's correlation risk: if Barcelona have an off night, it costs you three times.
Selling Feliz goes against the crowd (36% own him). If Madrid's guards stay out he keeps scoring and you lose ground on the managers who kept him.
Uses all 4 trades, so nothing is left for Tuesday's injury news.
cancel_if: Real Madrid confirm Campazzo is out for R12 and R13 as well: then keep Feliz and play A.

alerts.text: Lineup: Davidovac and Joksimović are in active slots while Nunn, Diarra and Malcolm sit on the 50% bench. Fix this before Tuesday's deadline (worth about +11).
Coach Partizan: Valencia are 58% favourites in Belgrade. Partizan are still without Hayes, Allman and Willis, and Chris Silva is only arriving now (medicals done, not yet integrated).
Feliz's minutes depend on injuries: Campazzo is 'out indefinitely' with a biceps femoris strain and no timetable; Maledon and Deck are also out. Watch Monday's Real Madrid medical report.
Madar: Maccabi's sporting director said publicly they're looking for backcourt help. A new guard signing would cut Madar's role. Not imminent, but worth watching.
Turn structure: 9 of 10 R12 games are Tuesday 17 Nov. Only Beşiktaš vs Real Madrid is on Wednesday, so Feliz (and Llull/Abalde if bought) are your only late-turn options.

rumours.text: Poeta sacked; Luca Banchi back as head coach while also coaching Italy. The press calls the roster 'badly built' and the club has dropped its pursuit of Mike Tobey.
rumours.impact: New coach means a rotation reshuffle, with Bolmaro the new leader in the Gazzetta's view. Avoid Milano role players until the minutes settle, but they're a good opponent for your coach in R13.

rumours.text: Chris Silva arrived from Fenerbahçe for medicals and is completing the transfer.
rumours.impact: Extra frontcourt depth for your coach team in a few weeks. It slightly lowers Fenerbahçe's big-man depth too, but not enough to change the R12 pick.

rumours.text: Kenan Kamenjaš signed on loan from Dubai until the end of the season. Baskonia (1-10) collapsed in the 4th quarter in Belgrade.
rumours.impact: More bigs at Baskonia means fewer frontcourt minutes, which is bad news for Joksimović. Sell him in the R14 unlimited window.

rumours.text: Marcelinho Huertas (43) is joining Dubai from Tenerife while Walkup is out with a back injury.
rumours.impact: A veteran point guard eats into McKinley Wright and Okobo's minutes and assists. Avoid Dubai guards. Bacon (a forward) is not affected.

rumours.text: Mičić admits 'sometimes we have different opinions' with Itoudis, but says they're united and he wants to retire at Hapoel.
rumours.impact: Mild chemistry noise, no role change. Hapoel are still 75% at Baskonia, so the HTA coach (7.9) is a fallback option.

rumours.text: The appeal against the sanctions (-2 and Jones' suspension) was rejected. Dorsey is out on a 'club decision', and Bartzokas says 'good players don't leave their teams'.
rumours.impact: Dorsey's situation looks like a possible exit, which means more shots for Vezenkov. Supports keeping him as captain.

rumours.text: Turkish press ran 'bad news from Melli' after the Paris loss. Not confirmed: no injury report lists him.
rumours.impact: Check Monday's Fenerbahçe report before buying the coach. If Melli is out, they're still about 80% vs ASVEL.

rumours.text: Casarin out about 8 weeks (tibial plateau fracture); Hackett added to the injury report. Abass is returning to the rotation.
rumours.impact: Thinner Virtus guard rotation; Diarra's role is unchanged.

players.name: Sasha Vezenkov
players.read: 28 PIR in 33.8 minutes last round and 23 over his last 3. Dorsey and Montero are out, so his usage stays high. Price rising (+0.2).

players.name: Andres Feliz
players.read: Minutes jumped to 33.9 because of Madrid's injuries. Your only Wednesday player. A sell-high candidate once the guards return (see Variation C).

players.name: Kendrick Nunn
players.read: Good form (22.3 over his last 3), but starts only 25% of the time and has a B2B at Zalgiris in R13. Robinson does the same job for 2 credits less with a bigger role.

players.name: Yam Madar
players.read: Starts 80% of the time and is cheap at 10.5, but Maccabi are underdogs in both rounds (OLY, then DUB on a B2B) and are shopping for a guard. 6th man.

players.name: Collin Malcolm
players.read: 30 minutes as a starter and 18.3 PIR over his last 3. R13 vs ASVEL is the best matchup on your team.

players.name: Aliou Diarra
players.read: 1.0 PIR per minute, 38% owned, price up 4.3 since the start. A tough matchup with Lessort, but he's template protection.

players.name: Mouhamed Faye
players.read: 20.9 in R11 and Paris are +16 with him on court. A 10.1 average and Barcelona away next. Bench him, then sell in the R14 window after the price rise.

players.name: Dejan Davidovac
players.read: 12 minutes off the bench. Zvezda's frontcourt injuries (Motley, Koloko, Miljenović) could push him into small-ball minutes, but not yet. Budget filler.

players.name: Dario Brizuela
players.read: Punter's absence gives him only about 0.6 extra minutes; Robinson gets the ball. Budget filler with two home games.

players.name: Stefan Joksimovic
players.read: 3.2 PIR/game. Kamenjaš's arrival squeezes the frontcourt further. First out in the unlimited window.

watchlist.name: Elijah Bryant (HTA, 17.7)
watchlist.why: 22 PIR average; at Baskonia (1-10) in R12, then at Paris. A premium guard to target in the R14 unlimited window.

watchlist.name: Jonas Valančiūnas (ZAL, 16.9)
watchlist.why: 23 over his last 3; buy for the unlimited window if he handles the Panathinaikos B2B well.

watchlist.name: Mathias Lessort (PAN, 16.7)
watchlist.why: 21 PIR over his last 3, offensive-rebound monster; pairs with Panathinaikos' tough-defence schedule.

watchlist.name: Alberto Abalde (MAD, 6.1)
watchlist.why: 14 PIR over his last 3 in 23 minutes thanks to Madrid's injuries, and 21% owned. A cheap Wednesday enabler if you need one.

watchlist.name: Josh Nebo (BAR, 12.7)
watchlist.why: Barcelona's double-home double week. Becomes a buy if you sell Faye.

review: First report: nothing to grade yet. In R11 so far, Faye scored 20.9 in Paris' buzzer-beater win over Fenerbahçe, Peñarroya's Partizan beat Baskonia (+20 coach points), and Joksimović managed 2. Your Tuesday/Wednesday players are still to play tonight and tomorrow (Vezenkov vs Dubai, Feliz vs Zvezda, Madar vs Hapoel).
